title: 第807章 不信我你还能不信三冬吗？
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

相亲相爱一家人峰对于修士来说大算其实不得大，而且并非每个地方都值得去。

光秃秃不好看的地方三冬便不会带着钱清去。

它带钱清去的地方都是三冬认真的好地方。

例如可以在一个小坡边远望的蛟龙盘踞休息，可以数蛟龙身上的鳞片有几枚。

再漫步到小溪边感受溪水的冰凉以及看着不怕人的小鱼婉转其中。

三冬还能找到小白虎，让小白虎托着自己和钱清漫步而行。

第一次看到小白虎的钱清表情有些诧异，甚至坐上小白虎的时候三冬也能感觉到钱清紧绷的身躯。

三冬拍着小白虎的脑袋告诉钱清，面前的小白虎是个乖巧的好虎。

钱清坐了片刻，发现白虎的确温顺的有些让人发指的程度。

有时候遇见不理解的事，钱清也找到了能让自己立刻理解的想法——这就是仙家。

仙家有些不正常的地方也很正常。

例如乖巧的白虎，例如打喷嚏便有云雾的蛟龙。

有仗剑飞梭的修士，有温和可爱的花精。

难怪世人说天大地大仙家最大，修得一身武艺通天不过修士一眼百年。

修士的世界是另一种截然不同的万千缤纷。

另外本以为缘空那个傻和尚也认识不了什么大人物，毕竟一个兜里穷的都没几分钱，还要做什么好事，赚钱只靠卖艺的蠢和尚怎么可能会认识大人物。

但很明显，上次碰面喝过酒的楚星尘是真的不得了的大人物。

来的路上，倒悬寺的小和尚总是在说天衍宗是天顶星级别的宗门，说是天下最大十八宗门之一，可以媲美中州大雷音寺佛门的水平。

天底下的修士最大的梦想就是加入其中。

武夫心该无惧，拳心如心。

可是真看见这一切，只是这一角就让人下意识的不知所措。

钱清感受这身下白虎矫健的动作，望向了前方笑的灿烂的花精，低声问出了一个已经知道结果的问题：

“修仙要灵根是吗？”

“人的话，应该是吧？”

“没有灵根真的修不了仙吗？”

“掌门说世上没有什么是绝对的，但这个问题三冬不知道，等掌门回来你可以问掌门，掌门知道的可全了，或者问天衍宗的掌门，一个叫吕玄的老爷爷，大家说他们算命很准，或者问问衍韵，她也很厉害。”

钱清忽然释然一笑，两只手轻轻抓住了白虎的皮毛道：

“罢了，不用问了。”

要是没灵根也能修仙，那么这世间早都是修士了。

三冬目光转回，望向钱清：

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The Peak of Love and Family is not a big deal for monks, and not every place is worth visiting.

San Dong would not take money to clean up a bare and unsightly place.

The places it takes Qianqing to are all good places for Sandong to be serious about.

For example, you can watch a dragon resting on the edge of a small slope and count the number of scales on its body.

Then stroll to the creek and feel the coolness of the water and the small fish that don't look afraid of people.

Sandong could also find the little white tiger, and let the little white tiger support him and Qian Qing while walking.

Qian Qing's expression was a little surprised when he saw the little white tiger for the first time. Even when Sandong sat on the little white tiger, he could feel Qian Qing's tight body.

Sandong patted the little white tiger on the head and told Qian Qing that the little white tiger in front of him was a well-behaved and good tiger.

Qian Qing sat for a while and found that Bai Hu was indeed docile to an outrageous degree.

Sometimes when he encounters something he doesn't understand, Qian Qing also finds an idea that allows him to understand it immediately - this is the Xian family.

Some abnormalities in the Xian family are also normal.

For example, the well-behaved white tiger, or the dragon that creates clouds of mist when it sneezes.

There are monks flying with swords and flying shuttles, and there are gentle and lovely flower essences.

No wonder people say that the great immortal family in the world is the largest, and his martial arts skills are as good as those of a monk who can only take a century.

The world of monks is a completely different and colorful one.

In addition, I thought that the stupid monk Yuan Kong would not know any big shots. After all, a poor man who only has a few cents in his pocket and wants to do good things, how could a stupid monk who makes money only by performing arts know a big shot.

But it was obvious that Chu Xingchen, who we had a drink with last time, was a really big shot.

On the way here, the young monk from Daoxuan Temple always said that Tianyan Sect was a Zenith Star-level sect, one of the eighteen largest sects in the world, comparable to the level of Buddhism at the Great Leiyin Temple in Zhongzhou.

The biggest dream of any monk in the world is to join it.

A warrior's heart should be fearless, and his fist should be as strong as his heart.

But seeing all of this, just this corner makes people subconsciously feel at a loss.

Qian Qing felt the vigorous movements of the white tiger under his body, looked at the flower essence smiling brightly in front of him, and asked a question in a low voice with the result of which he already knew:

"Does cultivating an immortal require spiritual roots?"

"As a human being, it should be right?"

"Is it true that you can't become an immortal without spiritual roots?"

"The leader said that nothing in the world is absolute, but San Dong doesn't know about this issue. When the leader comes back, you can ask the leader, and he will know everything. Or you can ask the leader of Tianyan Sect, an old man named Lu Xuan. Everyone says that they tell fortunes very accurately, or you can ask Yanyun, she is also very good."

Qian Qing suddenly smiled with relief, gently grabbed the white tiger's fur with both hands and said:

"That's all, no need to ask."

If one could cultivate immortality without spiritual roots, then the world would already be full of monks.

Sandong turned his eyes back to Qian Qing:
